name: professor-inreach
description: Find potential PhD supervisors, compare sourced faculty information, and draft thoughtful outreach emails.

interface.shortDescription: Find your research fit. Start the conversation.
interface.longDescription: Use your CV, project experience, and intended PhD topic to find potential supervisors. Compare sourced research, citation counts, academic titles, listed students, and recruiting statements, then draft a personal email.
defaultPrompt: Use my CV and research interests to find PhD supervisors.
Compare these professors' research, groups, and recruiting.
Draft an email explaining my fit with this professor.
